topics.dmca: Mot Phim aggregates public third-party embed links and does not store or host any video files on its servers. Please contact copyright@motphim.local with takedown notices including direct source URLs.

topics.privacy: Account data (email, favorites sync, and watch party sessions) is stored securely in Firebase strictly to power authentication and cross-device playback features.
topics.ads: Interested in banner placements or content collaborations? Reach our partnerships team at ads@motphim.local.
topics.feedback: Found a broken stream, subtitle sync issue, or UI bug? Share the movie title and episode details with support@motphim.local so we can investigate promptly.
